raw_text: Identify different modes of communication: print, digital, auditory, and visual. (I)
competency_statement: Identify different ways people communicate, including print, digital, auditory, and visual modes.
observable_behaviors: Point out examples of print communication such as books or newspapers.
Recognize digital communication like websites or apps.
Identify auditory communication such as spoken words or sounds.
Recognize visual communication like pictures or videos.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify different modes of communication when presented with examples.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Sort or categorize examples by communication mode (print, digital, auditory, visual).
